code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_bars = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    def regions(n, bars):
        bounds = [-1] + bars + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]
    rs, cs = regions(h, row_bars), regions(w, col_bars)
    marks = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rs):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cs):
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8):
                        marks.append((ri, ci, grid[r][c]))
    paints = {}
    for ri, ci, color in marks:
        for rj, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rs):
            for cj, (c0, c1) in enumerate(cs):
                if rj == ri or cj == ci:
                    key = (rj, cj)
                    paints.setdefault(key, set()).add(color)

        r0, r1 = rs[ri]; c0, c1 = cs[ci]
        for r in range(r0, r1):
            for c in range(c0, c1):

    return out
'''
